title: नेपालको आर्थिक विकासमा लघु, घरेलु तथा साना उद्योगको भूमिका Nepalko Arthik Bikasma Laghu, Gharelu tatha Sana Uddhyogko Bhumika
authors: लुइटेल Luitel, बिष्णु Bishnu बहादुर Bahadur
nepali: यस अध्ययनको मुख्य उद्देश्य लघु घरेलु तथा साना उद्योग/व्यवसाय (MCSIs/MCSEs) ले नेपालको आर्थिक विकासमा खेलेको भूमिकाको विश्लेषण गर्नु हो । नेपालको सन्दर्भमा गरिवी (आर्थिक अवनति) लाई घटाउनु मुख्य चुनौती हो । त्यसकारण यस अध्ययनले MCSI/MCSEs  को भूमिकालाई बृहत्तर पारी गरिवी घटाई आर्थिक विकास गर्नसक्छ भन्ने कुरालाई स्पष्ट पारेको छ । यस अध्ययनले MCSI  क्षेत्रको विकास गर्नु भनेको नेपालको विकास गर्नु हो । त्यसैले विकसित नेपाल CSI को विकासबाट मात्र सम्भव छ भन्ने कुरा बताउँछ । हाम्रो देशका उद्योगका उत्पादन दिनानुदिन बढ्नु पर्नेमा यो घट्दै गइरहेको छ । त्यसकारण नेपाल सरकारले यस क्षेत्रलाई प्राथमिकता क्रममा राखी विकसित नेपालको प्रक्रिया थाल्नुपर्छ । यस अध्ययनमा प्रयोग गरेका तथ्य/सूचना प्राथमिक स्रोतमा आधारित छन् र यस अध्ययनलाई अनुसन्धान कर्ताले तीन उपशीर्षकमा विभाजित गरी तल प्रस्तुत गरेको छ ।
american_english: The main objective of this study is to analyze the role played by small, cottage and micro-scale industries/enterprises (MCSIs/MCSEs) in Nepal's economic development. In the context of Nepal, reducing poverty (economic decline) is the main challenge. For that reason, this study has made clear that the role of MCSIs/MCSEs can reduce poverty on a wider scale and bring about economic development. This study shows that developing the MCSI sector means developing Nepal. It therefore tells us that a developed Nepal is possible only through the development of CSIs. Although the industrial output of our country should be increasing day by day, it is steadily declining. For that reason, the Government of Nepal must give this sector priority and launch the process toward a developed Nepal. The data/information used in this study are based on primary sources, and the researcher has divided the study into three subheadings and presented it below.

informal_english: The whole point of this study is to look at the part small, home-based and micro-sized industries and businesses (MCSIs/MCSEs) play in Nepal's economic growth. In Nepal's case, tackling poverty - that is, economic decline - is the big challenge. And so the study has spelt out how the role of MCSIs/MCSEs can, on a much bigger scale, cut poverty and get the economy moving. The study shows that developing the MCSI sector is really developing Nepal. Which means a developed Nepal is only doable through developing CSIs. Our country's industrial output should be rising day by day, yet it is falling instead. So the Government of Nepal has got to put this sector up front and kick off the push for a developed Nepal. The facts and figures used here come straight from primary sources, and the researcher has broken the study into three subheadings and laid it out below.
